name: AIS1
summary: AIS1 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average-based signals to identify and trade with the prevailing market trend. It enters positions when trend conditions align and manages trades with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, applying consistent rules across all trades.
summary_zh: AIS1是一个趋势跟踪型EA，基于移动平均线信号识别并跟随当前市场趋势进行交易。当趋势条件满足时开仓，并使用固定止损和止盈管理交易。该EA完全系统化运行，无需人工干预，对所有交易应用一致的规则。
strategy_analysis: AIS1采用趋势跟踪策略，通过移动平均线的交叉或方向判断市场趋势方向。入场条件基于价格与移动平均线的关系或均线交叉信号，当多头趋势确立时做多，空头趋势确立时做空。出场条件使用固定止损和止盈，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式。资金管理方面，止损设置确保单笔亏损可控，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: AIS1 employs a trend-following strategy that identifies market direction through moving average crossovers or price-MA relationships. Entry conditions are triggered when bullish trend signals appear for longs and bearish signals for shorts, typically based on MA alignment or crossover events. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some implementations potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation relative to account balance. Money management ensures single-trade risk is controlled via stop-loss settings, but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on volatility or market conditions. The strategy is logically clear and effective in trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy environments leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

parameters.name: MAMethod
parameters.description: 移动平均线计算方法(0=简单,1=指数)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in pips, activates after price moves beyond this

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，趋势跟踪是经过验证的交易理念
使用固定止损止盈，风险参数明确可控
系统化执行消除情绪干扰，交易纪律性强
pros_en: Clear strategy logic with trend following being a proven trading concept
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide defined and controllable risk parameters
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference and ensures trading discipline
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号和连续亏损
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能止损过近
缺乏动态仓位管理机制，无法根据市场条件调整风险敞口
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss does not account for volatility changes, potentially too close during high volatility periods
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡市中减少或暂停交易
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add market state filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce or pause trading in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapts to current market volatility

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑波动率，高波动期可能被频繁止损
缺乏最大回撤控制和连续亏损限制机制
未检查账户保证金水平，极端行情下可能爆仓
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss ignores volatility, leading to frequent stops during high volatility periods
No maximum drawdown control or consecutive loss limit mechanism
No margin level check, risking margin call during extreme market conditions

It enters positions when trend conditions align and manages trades with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, applying consistent rules across all trades.
